tweets.text:
THANK YOU @realDonaldTrump @POTUS , @SecretaryBurgum @SecWar , and @SecKennedy from thousands of U.S. commercial fishermen who feed America and depend on safe waters to protect their families, crews, and coastal communities. 🙏🇺🇸💪🏻🌊⛴️🐟🦑

“The prime duty of the United States government is to protect the American people,” said Secretary of the Interior Doug Burgum. “Today’s action addresses emerging national security risks, including the rapid evolution of adversary technologies and the vulnerabilities created by large-scale offshore wind projects located near East Coast population centers.” https://t.co/ikpyvIv4ku 

America’s fishermen stand with our leaders who put national security, working families, and common sense first! We could not be more grateful!
